evals.prompt: 比较 MIT 和 Apache-2.0 的许可证选择。
expectations: Select open-source-license only for its own intended task.

evals.prompt: 检查 GPL 依赖的合规条件并准备 NOTICE。
expectations: Select open-source-license only for its own intended task.

evals.prompt: 修复一个带 LICENSE 文件的项目。
expectations: Do not select open-source-license for this adjacent task.

evals.prompt: 解释项目采用的技术栈。
expectations: Do not select open-source-license for this adjacent task.

evals.prompt: Our GPL-2.0 dependency says "or any later version". Can we combine Apache-2.0 code? Explain conditions; do not relicense files.
expectations: Considers GPLv3 only if the complete combination permits it.
Does not silently change license files or claim unconditional compatibility.

evals.prompt: A proprietary application statically links LGPL-3.0 code. Another unchanged AGPL program is distributed as a binary, not a service. What facts and obligations need checking?
expectations: Does not categorically prohibit LGPL static linking; identifies relinking/source/notices conditions.
Does not dismiss AGPL distribution duties merely because it is unchanged or not SaaS.
Gives conditional guidance tied to exact versions and distribution facts.

evals.prompt: Generate an MIT LICENSE, but copyright holder/year are missing and no canonical text can be verified.
expectations: Does not fabricate holder/year or reconstruct legal text from memory.
Does not overwrite an existing project license.
